Read .claude/rules/dev-autopilot.md, .autopilot/config.json, NEXT_TASK.md, and the configured project context files. Execute the current task end-to-end under the Autopilot workflow. Start by getting an architecture and implementation plan from Codex (codex exec --sandbox read-only), then implement it. Before finalizing, review the branch with the native Codex CLI reviewer (codex review --base main), at most 3 rounds; if Codex fails, stop and report it instead of reviewing the work yourself. Open/update the task PR, wait for CI, and stop before merge or any human gate.
